request: 我决定office插件后面永久弃用，强力把aide的libreoffice的功能做好；优先 LibreOffice 版式预览与兼容性
acceptance: Open Office and ODF layout previews offline with no plugin or service address
Copy and deliver Office preview files as streams without fixed byte limits
Prevent legacy plugin execution and installation while preserving persisted settings/files
Retain XLSX cell edits, DOCX comments and six built-in AI tool contracts with existing permission/version controls
scope: Aide native Office viewer, LibreOffice runtime, private preview staging and HTTP range delivery
Retire legacy Office plugin activation/installation and internalize its six AI tools
Stage marketplace delisting and standalone archive notice while preserving old releases

requirements.summary: Retire Office plugin permanently and prioritize LibreOffice layout compatibility. User explicitly removes fixed Office read cap.

design.summary: Private LibreOffice document snapshot with no fixed byte limit. Authorized PDF Range reads share the rendered snapshot. Keep content editing controls and preserve existing state.

implementation.summary: Writer/Calc/Impress, nine format routes, private disk staging, streamed PDFs, retired plugin intake, and native tools implemented.

verification.summary: Offline LibreOffice covered nine formats and Chromium rendered an 81 MiB DOCX with authorized PDF ranges. The merged-cell fixture verified that the full XLSX title and text were visible. The 68f711f9 Go race and vet run completed with 1,701 cases passed and 94 recorded skips. Runtime assets and renderer checks passed separately with the LibreOffice runtime image. Structured reading of a 128.9 MiB DOCX and lock, visibility and cancellation cases passed on c2549c6a.

documentation.summary: Current Office instructions describe component and page preview, limits and retirement.

cleanup.summary: The isolated Office verification containers were removed after evidence capture. The original workspace, plugin files and historical release assets were preserved.

release.summary: The independent Office plugin is retired and absent from the live market. Historical downloads remain available. A new Aide application build and delivery were outside the plugin release request.

release_authorization: User authorized incremental merge and plugin publication, and explicitly retired the stand-alone Office plugin on 2026-11-18.
rollback: Legacy plugins and release assets retained. Existing daily image and workspace data separate. Source rollback uses the isolated feature branch and current main baseline.
handoff: Built-in source is on Aide main. Layout preview and office_document_read stream source files without a fixed byte cutoff. Some legacy reads and writes still use their original guards. Daily Aide remains on its previous application image.
